style.name: international poetic realism

camera.name: ARRI Alexa 65
camera.texture: extremely gentle highlight rolloff, sky never clips to white, deep retained shadow detail at night

grade.palette: harvest night is orange machinery lamps against a lifted near-black blue sky; skin tones desaturated, no HDR glow
grade.contrast: filmic S-curve with fully retained shadow detail, black sky kept slightly lifted so wind motion stays readable
grade.grain: fine 35mm grain, marginally coarser on high-wind exterior shots
grade.halation: visible halation around combine headlamps only

photoreal: photorealistic live-action film still, shot on a real cinema camera
authentic skin texture with visible pores, fine facial hair and natural subsurface scattering
real fabric weave, visible seams, natural wear and creases in wardrobe
motivated practical light sources visible in frame
shallow depth of field with organic bokeh, some foreground occlusion
subtle film grain, gentle halation around highlights, natural highlight rolloff
slightly imperfect framing and focus like a real camera operator
true-to-life color science, desaturated skin tones, no HDR glow
rural north China plain at night, dust and chaff suspended in the air, no set dressing gloss, no CGI sheen
style.score: no music at all; only wind, diesel engines, wheat stalks

shots.description: 大远景：夜里的麦田，风把整片麦浪按下去，画面里没有一个人
shots.action_en: extreme wide shot of an immense wheat field at night, wind pressing the entire expanse of standing wheat down in one slow travelling wave from the far left toward camera, no figures, no moon, a faint lifted dark blue sky above a low horizon, chaff drifting in the air
shots.shot_size_en: extreme wide establishing shot, vast scale, tiny human figure
shots.camera_move_en: locked-off tripod, completely static frame, no camera movement

light.key: no practical source at all; only the last blue residue of dusk and starlight

composition.frame: horizon on the lower third, the wheat field filling the bottom, a large empty dark sky above
composition.subject_pos: no subject — the travelling wave of wheat is the subject
composition.negative_space: the upper two thirds is empty dark sky, held deliberately for the opening title

beats.text: 风把整片麦子按下去，又抬起来。

shots.continuity: 全片第一镜。天占三分之二的构图纪律在这里定下。本片唯一一次出现空白天空留给片名。

shots.description: 大远景：收割机车队从地平线上升起，排成一列，灯光扫过麦浪，雾里有一道人影
shots.action_en: extreme wide night shot looking along a harvested lane through standing wheat as a long line of combine harvesters stretches back toward the horizon, their warm tungsten lamps flaring in low ground mist and casting long radial shadows across the stubble, one small distant human silhouette standing at the far left edge of the field
shots.shot_size_en: extreme wide establishing shot, vast scale, tiny human figure
shots.camera_move_en: locked-off tripod, completely static frame, no camera movement

light.key: a receding line of combine harvester headlamp arrays, warm tungsten, flaring in ground mist
light.direction: from the horizon toward camera, raking across the stubble
light.practical: the combine headlamps themselves, visible in frame

composition.frame: the machine line running diagonally from the right foreground to the horizon on the left third, a tiny figure at the extreme left edge
composition.subject_pos: the machine line occupying the centre and right, the human figure on the far left third
composition.headroom: n/a — the figure is a silhouette at distance
composition.negative_space: the dark misty sky above the lamps

beats.text: 一个一个从地平线下面升起来。排成一列。

shots.continuity: 全片最重要的场面镜。灯必须是一列、有纵深、在雾里形成光晕与放射状阴影。人影只作剪影，不给正脸。

shots.description: 全景：两盏探照灯同时转到她身上，把她的背影从黑暗里捞出来照得发白，又转走
shots.action_en: full shot from behind of a woman standing on a raised earth path between wheat fields at night as two combine harvester searchlights swing onto her at once, blowing her dark jacket to near-white and throwing her long shadow forward into the crop, the beams then sweeping away and dropping her back into total darkness
shots.shot_size_en: full shot, whole body head to toe with headroom
shots.camera_move_en: locked-off tripod, completely static frame, no camera movement

light.key: two combine harvester searchlights swinging onto the subject from behind camera-left
light.ratio: 2:1 when lit, then 40:1 after the lamps leave
light.practical: the two searchlights themselves, entering frame

composition.frame: subject centred on the path, back to camera, the two beams entering from the left edge
composition.headroom: generous headroom, no crop on face or hands
composition.negative_space: total black on either side of the beam

beats.text: 灯转过来，把她照得发白。
灯转走了。她又被还回黑暗里。

shots.continuity: 【本片的题眼】。被照亮、又被还回黑暗。全片最后一镜将重复这个节奏。必须背对镜头——本片主角永不给正脸近景。

shots.location: 华北平原 · 收割后的麦田
shots.description: 近景：她蹲在收割过的地里，伸手按住一把麦茬——风想把它吹走，她压着
shots.action_en: medium close-up of a woman crouched low in a cut wheat field at night, one large weathered hand pressed flat down on a clump of stubble as the wind tries to tear it loose, thick knuckles and nails cut to the flesh, her face turned away and lost in darkness, only the faint sky above the horizon line
shots.camera_move_en: locked-off tripod, completely static frame, no camera movement

light.key: no lamp; only the faint lifted night sky from behind, the hand nearly lost in darkness
light.direction: top and behind, from the sky

composition.frame: the hand and stubble in the lower third, the subject's back and shoulder above in soft darkness
composition.subject_pos: the hand centred in the lower third
composition.headroom: normal headroom, no crop on face or hands

beats.emotion: 一个人对一整片平原的抵抗

shots.continuity: 【本片形式骨架动作：蹲下压住被风掀起的东西】。此动作在全片五地各出现一次。不给正脸。

shots.description: 中景：她把睡着的小孩用旧棉被裹好放进拖拉机后斗；风把脖子上的红布条吹起来，她塞进衣领
shots.action_en: medium shot in a dark farmyard at night as a woman lays a sleeping child wrapped in a worn quilt into the trailer of a small tractor, one bare wall bulb lighting her from the side, then a faded red cloth strip knotted at her throat lifts in the wind and she tucks it in under her collar with one hand
shots.camera_move_en: locked-off tripod, completely static frame, no camera movement

light.key: a single bare wall bulb in the yard, hard and small, with faint kitchen light through a window
light.practical: the bare yard bulb visible on the wall in frame

composition.frame: tractor trailer on the left third, the woman on the right third, dark yard behind
composition.subject_pos: subject on the right third, in near-profile with her face turned down toward the child
composition.headroom: normal headroom, no crop on face or hands
composition.negative_space: the black yard opening between them

beats.text: 她把小孩裹好，放进后斗。
红布条被风吹起来。她把它塞进衣领。
beats.emotion: 全片唯一一件她带走的旧东西

shots.continuity: 【红布条是全片唯一的情感道具】，颜色必须褪到灰白，不是鲜红。孩子只给裹在被子里的形体，不给正脸。

shots.description: 大特写：后视镜里，村子的灯一点一点退下去，最后剩下一颗，然后是零
shots.action_en: extreme close-up of a small cracked tractor side mirror at pre-dawn reflecting a receding line of village window lights across dark fields, the lamps shrinking one by one until a single point remains and then goes out, the driver's face deliberately out of frame
shots.shot_size_en: extreme close-up on a single detail, very shallow focus
shots.camera_move_en: locked-off tripod, completely static frame, no camera movement

lens.dof: extreme shallow focus on one detail

light.key: distant village window lamps reflected in the mirror glass, plus the first grey of pre-dawn sky
light.quality: tiny warm point sources against cold ambient grey
light.practical: the reflected village lamps are the only warm light

composition.frame: the mirror filling the left two thirds, black road and pre-dawn sky in the right third
composition.subject_pos: the mirror on the left third, no face in frame
composition.headroom: n/a — mirror only, the driver's face deliberately excluded
composition.negative_space: the empty pre-dawn road in the right third

beats.text: 一点一点退下去。最后剩下一颗。

shots.continuity: 【第一场结尾】。此镜之后接字幕卡：北纬 43.2° 东经 76.9°。全片最后一镜将回到本镜的反向运动。

characters.name: 李秀云
characters.age: 38 years old at the start of the film (born 1977)
characters.build: 163cm, broad-shouldered and strong from field and manual labour, hands notably large
characters.hair: black hair pulled back into a single bun tied with a plain black elastic band, strands always escaping into the wind
characters.face: wind-reddened cheeks, freckles across the cheekbones, faint untended eyebrows, thin cracked lower lip
characters.skin: coarse weathered skin, visible pores, fine lines at the temples and eye corners, a dark tan line on the forearms where the sleeves end
characters.eyes: single-lidded, a direct level gaze that narrows once when measuring a distance
distinctive: an old sickle scar on the side of the right index finger
a faded red cloth strip knotted at the throat, worn to grey-pink, from the year her son was born
sleeves always rolled to the elbow
characters.wardrobe: blue-and-white checked cotton shirt under a faded army-green work jacket, canvas shoes with mud on them
characters.voice: low, flat, extremely short sentences; she speaks eleven times in the entire film

characters.name: 儿子
characters.build: thin five-year-old boy, small for his age
characters.face: soft round child's face, eyes closed in sleep — never shown awake or in close-up
characters.skin: smooth child's skin with a faint chapped redness on the cheeks from cold
characters.eyes: closed throughout; he is never shown awake
distinctive: one bare arm always outside the quilt in sleep
characters.wardrobe: a faded old cotton undershirt, wrapped in a worn quilt washed pale
characters.voice: no dialogue in the entire film
